en.headline: Hong Kong airport passenger traffic rises 10.2 per cent in September
en.dek: Hong Kong International Airport handled 4.86 million passengers last month, driven by transfer traffic, and received three best-airport awards.
body: Hong Kong International Airport recorded a 10.2 per cent year-on-year rise in passenger traffic in September, handling 4.86 million passengers, the Airport Authority said on Tuesday.

Flight movements increased 7 per cent to 32,175 and cargo volume grew 6.3 per cent to 433,000 tonnes. Transfer and transit passengers continued to drive overall growth, while visitor arrivals rose 5 per cent. Growth was led by the Chinese mainland market.

The airport also received three best-airport honours, including Asia’s Leading Airport at the World Travel Awards for the sixth consecutive year, China’s Leading Airport for the fifth year, and a 14th consecutive Travel Hall of Fame title at the TTG Travel Awards. Chief Executive Officer Vivian Cheung said the recognitions affirmed the collective efforts of the airport community.

zh.headline: 香港國際機場九月客運量按年升百分之十點二
zh.dek: 機場管理局周二公布，九月處理486萬人次旅客，按年升百分之十點二，主要由轉機旅客帶動，並獲三項最佳機場殊榮。
body: 香港國際機場管理局周二公布，九月客運量按年上升百分之十點二，共處理486萬人次旅客。
飛機起降量上升百分之七至32,175架次，貨運量增長百分之六點三至43.3萬公噸。整體增長主要由轉機及過境旅客的雙位數升幅帶動，訪港旅客亦按年升百分之五，內地市場表現最為突出。
機場同時獲三項最佳機場殊榮，包括連續第六年獲世界旅遊獎選為亞洲最佳機場、連續第五年獲中國最佳機場，以及連續第十四年獲TTG旅遊大獎旅遊名人堂最佳機場。行政總裁張李佳蕙表示，獎項肯定了整個機場同業的共同努力。
